palette.notes: Measured palette_size 1 is unreliable (the last third is a blank end card). Visibly: blue night interior, pink and black pyjamas, warm wood floor and a cool lamp light.

lighting: One cool ceiling lamp and a blue night window; warm brown floor and counter give contrast; soft contact shadows under feet.
silhouette: Two chibi-proportioned figures in contrasting pink and black outfits; each pose reads clearly against the darker room.

motion.timing: Holds median 83.3 ms (on 2.5s, 4.15 drawings/s). About 8 s of story: pour coffee, walk over, offer the cup, kiss; then the end card.

texture: Native 288x288 at 2x, clean pixels, very little dither; soft painted shading on the room, flatter on the characters.
camera: Locked square frame, one room, no cuts; the characters move inside it.

acting.enters: Both start in frame; he is at the counter, she sits on the bench.
acting.acts: He pours, turns, walks a few steps holding the cup, hands it over; she takes it and they kiss: a tiny story told with poses.
acting.exits: No exit; ends on the kiss and cuts to the end card.
acting.depth: Both on one mid-ground plane; the table and chairs on the right give room depth.

techniques: tiny story in one locked room: give, receive, react
contrasting costume colours to separate two characters
short walk to close the distance between two characters
warm floor against cool night light
feel: cool night room + warm floor + two contrast-coloured characters + one gesture story = cozy shared moment
for_fred: Give Fred and Pixie a two-character exchange: Fred walks over and hands Pixie something, she reacts. One clear give-and-take in a held frame beats looping the same bounce.
